name: plan-clean
title: Planning against the doctor fixture above
note: Action 1 was `patch-marker-block` until the RFC 0006 transcript was amended: strict JSON has no comment syntax, so a marker fence in settings.json produces a document the harness cannot parse, and RFC 0004 §Ownership lists fences and JSON entries as separate mechanisms. It is now `merge-json` appending one element to `hooks.PreToolUse`, which is the live shape the Phase 2.5 spike observed and which leaves the user's other hook entries and their order intact. The payloads themselves were added in PLAN §15 issue 6, because RFC 0006 §Plan persistence makes `apply --plan` execute the artifact a reviewer approved, which requires the bytes to be in the plan.
